programs.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programs.desc: Fuding—the land of white tea— is the perfect place for Foodwise hosts Tianran and Hannah to spend the Dragon Boat Festival. Watch them wrap sticky rice dumplings called zongzi, feast on a variety of local snacks and experience the ultimate white tea banquet. From the sea to the mountains, every stop promises a new taste of Fujian.

programs.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programs.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their travels in Fujian province, this time they visit the birthplace of oolong tea. There's plenty to do, from tasting local specialties like rock tea and braised goose to bamboo rafting and hiking Tianyou Peak. To cap it all off, they'll attend a Zhu Xi banquet, named after one of China's greatest Neo-Confucian scholars.

programs.title: My Village is a National Treasure Ep.3
programs.desc: Dingcun village in Shanxi has a deep cultural legacy borne from a long historical tradition. Yet despite its rich resources, the village remained stagnant for years, described by local scholars as “begging for food while holding a golden bowl.” Now, Dingcun is charting a new course, developing its rural tourism by embracing its unique cultural assets.
